content: Hello! how can I help today?
§163(j) is limiting my interest deduction. Any way to fully deduct?

You can **elect real property trade or business** status to **opt out of §163(j)** limits. File the irrevocable election statement with your return, then use **ADS lives** for specified real property and **forego bonus depreciation** on those assets.

1) Confirm you meet **real property trade or business** criteria.
2) Attach the **§163(j)(7)** election statement identifying the electing trade(s).
3) Switch affected assets to **ADS** (e.g., 30-year resi, 40-year non-resi, as applicable).
4) Recompute depreciation and interest deduction; reflect on **Form 8990**.
Election statement copy, depreciation schedules showing ADS conversion, and **Form 8990** workpapers. Track bonus foregone and asset classes impacted for future dispositions.
